evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

observations.why: Declarative announcement of a decision controls the factual frame — supplying the outcome as established rather than arguing for it.
Evidence-and-logic argument for the switch, with the benefits framed as offered gains (performance, cost savings).
Summary header restates the decision as an established fact, controlling the informational frame of the record.
Quantified benefit presented as evidence supporting the decision — argument from data.
Fixing a deadline in the record imposes a time constraint on the migration — an insistence marker setting expectations.
